## Overview

This Quarto document demonstrates how **`glmap`** embeds multi-layer WebGL2 GPU maps directly into standalone HTML reports without the massive GeoJSON payload bloat of `leaflet`.

Because `glmap` compresses its C++17 `GEXP` (vector) and `GEXR` (`Float32` raster) binary buffers with `zlib`/`deflate` and decodes them in the browser via the native `DecompressionStream` API, this document remains **fast, compact, and 100% self-contained**.

```{r}
library(glmap)

# Generate synthetic Montreal - Quebec City corridor dataset
# (100,000 points, 2,000 polygons, and a 200x200 Float32 DEM raster)
bench <- gl_benchmark_data(
  n_points = 100000L,
  n_polygons = 2000L,
  raster_dim = c(200L, 200L)
)
```

## 1. Multi-Layer GPU Map (`terra` DEM + `sf` Polygons + Hexbins + 100k Points)

Use the **GPU Layers** panel (top-left) to toggle layers, or use the **GPU Shader Palette** dropdown and **Real-Time GPU Hillshade** checkbox (bottom-right) to recolor the `Float32` terrain model in **0 ms** on the GPU:

```{r}
glmap(basemap = gl_providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter) |>
  add_raster(
    bench$raster_mat,
    palette = "terrain",
    hillshade = TRUE,
    opacity = 0.70,
    group = "GPU Terrain DEM (Float32)"
  ) |>
  add_polygons(
    bench$polygons_sf,
    fill_color = ~elevation,
    palette = "viridis",
    fill_opacity = 0.65,
    group = "C++ Earcut Polygons (2k)"
  ) |>
  add_hexbin(
    bench$points_df,
    hex_radius = 0.035,
    palette = "plasma",
    opacity = 0.75,
    group = "C++ Hexbin Aggregation"
  ) |>
  add_points(
    bench$points_df,
    color = ~intensity,
    palette = "turbo",
    radius = 3.0,
    opacity = 0.85,
    group = "GPU Instanced Points (100k)"
  ) |>
  use_plugin("export_png")
```

## 2. Geodesic Circles, Bounding Rectangles & Halo Text Labels

`glmap` also provides drop-in equivalents for `leaflet::addCircles()` (radius in meters on the ground), `leaflet::addRectangles()`, and `leaflet::addLabelOnlyMarkers()`:

```{r}
hubs <- data.frame(
  lon = c(-73.5673, -71.2080, -72.5481, -71.8991),
  lat = c(45.5017,  46.8139,  46.3432,  45.4042),
  name = c("Montréal", "Québec", "Trois-Rivières", "Sherbrooke"),
  radius_m = c(18000, 15000, 12000, 12000),
  score = c(95, 88, 76, 81)
)

glmap(hubs, basemap = gl_providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  add_rectangles(
    lng1 = -74.0, lat1 = 45.1,
    lng2 = -70.8, lat2 = 47.1,
    fill_color = "#38bdf8",
    fill_opacity = 0.12,
    line_color = "#0284c7",
    line_width = 2,
    group = "Study Corridor"
  ) |>
  add_circles(
    radius = ~radius_m,
    fill_color = ~score,
    palette = "viridis",
    fill_opacity = 0.65,
    popup = ~name,
    group = "ServiceBuffers (m)"
  ) |>
  add_labels(
    text = ~name,
    size = 13,
    color = "#0f172a",
    halo_color = "#ffffff",
    group = "City Labels"
  )
```
